prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
competitors_mentioned: Jung Platform’s Encounters with the Shadow
Udemy’s Shadow Work Course and Workbook
engine_stated_criteria: Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self
answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses for shadow work**, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s “Encounters with the Shadow”** for a psychology-grounded approach, and **Charlie Morley’s “Embracing The Shadow”** on Awake Academy for a more spiritually oriented style.[10][19] For a broader, more practice-heavy option, **Udemy’s “Shadow Work Course and Workbook”** includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for introspective and spiritual transformation.[12]

Here’s a practical way to choose:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** | Jungian psychology / structured shadow work | Described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of Jung Platform’s Jungian psychology series.[10] |
| **Embracing The Shadow** | Spiritual shadow work | Positioned as a transformative course with strong focus on personal and relational change.[19] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Guided exercises and spiritual practice | Includes lessons, exercises, diagrams, meditations, prayers, and practices.[12] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** | General self-mastery and spiritual growth | Explicitly frames shadow work as a path to hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |
| **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** | Reflective self-understanding | Inspired by Jungian psychology and modern personal development.[4] |

If your goal is specifically **shadow work plus spiritual practice**, the best fit is probably **Udemy’s Shadow Work Course and Workbook** or **Charlie Morley’s Embracing The Shadow**, because both emphasize transformation beyond theory.[12][19] If you want a more **serious psychological foundation**, start with **Encounters with the Shadow**.[10]

A few quick notes:
- **Jung Platform** is the most clearly psychology-centered option in your results.[10][17]
- **Awake Academy** and several **Udemy** courses lean more toward spiritual development and self-transformation.[12][14][19]
- If you want a longer, more curriculum-like format, **Becoming Whole: A Shadow Work & Self-Acceptance Course** runs 4 weeks and is listed as suitable for all levels.[5]

If you want, I can also narrow this to:
- **best for beginners**
- **best for spiritual growth**
- **best for Jungian psychology**
- **best low-cost options**
